card.name: Start of a unit name after a number
card.fires_on: The first piece of a spelled-out measurement unit, or its abbreviation, right after a number or inside a parenthetical definition. Examples are SD, standard (deviations), international (units), b(pm) and G(y).

modes.label: Standard deviations
modes.description: SD or standard in growth z-score wording, or after a number such as 0.09.
modes.example: (measured in standard deviations [<<SD>>]), which normalize for natural growth of children

modes.label: International units
modes.description: The word international after a dose number, before units.
modes.example: A starting daily dose of 50<< international>> units of FOLLISTIM AQ Car

modes.label: Abbreviation in parentheses
modes.description: The first letter of an abbreviation such as bpm or Gy, given in parentheses after the spelled-out unit.
modes.example: greater than 2 gray (<<G>>y). Estimate a patient’s absorbed radiation

card.writes: It pushes the model to finish the unit word, favoring units, points and similar counting terms.
card.plain: It marks the start of a measurement unit such as SD, international units, bpm or Gy.
